patterns.note: Content is primarily centered horizontally on a full-bleed, vibrant blue background, creating a focused and immersive experience.
A single sans-serif typeface is used across the site, with a strong hierarchy established by large, bold headings and smaller, regular-weight body and form text.
The design relies heavily on a high-contrast, two-color palette of a dominant bright blue background and crisp white text, with minimal use of light grey for subtle elements.

As the user scrolls, the initial hero text and call-to-action scroll out of view, while a pixelated runner graphic scales up dramatically and animates its form, becoming the primary visual element on the page.
The page is structured into distinct conceptual areas: a bold hero statement, a detailed lead capture form, and a minimalist footer, all presented on the same continuous background.

technique_notes: The site uses a full-bleed background color that extends across the entire viewport, providing a consistent and immersive visual field.

Scroll-triggered animations are used to transition between content states: initial hero text and CTA elements are designed to scroll away, while a central graphic element scales up and animates its internal structure using CSS keyframes, creating a dynamic visual reveal as the user progresses down the page.
Form elements feature subtle rounded corners and a light grey fill against the vibrant background, providing clear visual contrast without breaking the minimalist aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) provide strong impact, complemented by smaller, regular-weight body and form text for clarity.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and form fields, maintaining a clean yet approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in the hero section emphasizes the bold statement, transitioning to a more balanced density for the form fields.

standout: The most distinctive aspect is the dynamic, pixelated runner graphic that animates and scales up as the user scrolls, transforming from a subtle accent into the page's central visual metaphor. This, combined with the singular, high-contrast blue and white palette, creates a memorable and highly focused experience.
